title: OpenCode LSP workstation setup harness
purpose: Give low-capability agents and Windows operators one deterministic path to recover a canonical checkout, recover the Windows-facing OpenCode runtime, inspect, configure, verify, and hand off OpenCode LSP enablement without changing product code, governance, secrets, or existing OpenCode configuration.

repositoryRecovery.proofRule: Only an exact canonical GitHub origin plus expected branch/head may become the setup worktree; a non-Git folder is preserved and never upgraded in place.

runtimeRecovery.proofRule: OPENCODE_NOT_FOUND routes through the registered runtime recovery router. Recovery requires LOCALAPPDATA so the router and Inspect use the same canonical AgentSwitchboard shim/state root. Initial discovery is limited to the registered user-local locations and never accepts inherited PATH. Before mutation, the router downloads the official installer once and verifies that the exact downloaded script still declares $HOME/.opencode/bin and supports --no-modify-path. After a successful official installer run, recovery judges only the official installer executable path $HOME/.opencode/bin/opencode rather than guessing alternate locations. Its bounded 30-second --version health probe records typed state, exit code, and failure class such as timeout, illegal-instruction, bus-error, segmentation-fault, missing, or not-executable while persisting no raw stderr. A healthy exact path is independently reproved before the canonical AgentSwitchboard shim is written, runtime-recovery receipt/report evidence is emitted, and bounded Inspect is re-entered automatically.

upstreamContract.stableLspRule: LSP is disabled by default; lsp=true enables built-in servers whose file types and prerequisites are present.
upstreamContract.configPrecedenceRule: OPENCODE_CONFIG_CONTENT is the highest runtime config source; the generated launcher preserves inherited inline values in memory and forces lsp=true there.
upstreamContract.interactiveModelRule: The current OpenCode TUI accepts --model/-m on the top-level opencode command.
upstreamContract.v2Boundary: Current OpenCode V2 documentation accepts LSP configuration but does not provide an LSP runtime; fail closed on a detected v2 command/version.

safety.proofCeiling: Static/hosted validation proves harness structure, installer-contract gating, typed post-install health classification, and setup logic. Checkout recovery can prove canonical repository acquisition and exact-head isolated worktree state. Runtime-recovery receipts can prove the bounded local discovery/version/install/shim/Inspect-handoff state without persisting raw OpenCode stderr, environment contents, or credentials. Workstation execution can prove OpenCode command/version resolution, immutable machine-local config artifacts, model visibility, and launcher generation. Active LSP diagnostics require opening a supported file and observing runtime behavior.
